# Priscilla Grant

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is a fair and pale maiden, described as having an ethereal, spiritual quality to her golden beauty. She has also been seen elegantly dressed in silk attire.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)_

## Personality

Despite her pale and spiritual appearance, Priscilla Grant possesses a lively demeanor. She is naturally inclined toward lightheartedness, enjoying fun, pranks, and mischief.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- full to the brim of mischief and pranks and fun  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and later taught school in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). She joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) on a spring walk in the woods, where they discovered Hester Gray's forgotten garden. Priscilla later made an unexpected visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) accompanied by the author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). Upon traveling to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) to study at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Priscilla greeted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the station and brought her to their initial boardinghouse. The two girls quickly befriended fellow freshman [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) while visiting Old St. John's Cemetery. After searching for a residence for their upcoming school year, Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secured Patty's Place from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford, moving in alongside Philippa, [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md). Priscilla spent part of the following summer visiting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) before completing her studies and graduating from [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P0](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0000), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P8](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0008), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), +35 more_

## Quotes

> "It would be too good to be true. Fairy tales don’t happen nowadays. I won’t hope, Anne. The disappointment would be too awful to bear. They’re sure to want more for it than we can afford. Remember, it’s on Spofford Avenue."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Friend P31](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0031)

> "This cake is now what you might call a flat failure. And the cushion is likewise ruined. Never tell me that Friday isn’t unlucky."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P35](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0035)

> “Little did I think the day would ever come when I’d be glad of the sight of a Sloane,” said Priscilla, as they crossed the campus, “but I’d welcome Charlie’s goggle eyes almost ecstatically. At least, they’d be familiar eyes.”
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Lady P4](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0004)

> "She talks as much about boys as Ruby Gillis does. But it always enrages or sickens me to hear Ruby, whereas I just wanted to laugh good-naturedly at Phil. Now, what is the why of that?"
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Lady P70](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0070)

> "Here you are, beloved! And I suppose you’re as tired as I was when I got here Saturday night."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Farewell P11](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0011)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) have been intimate friends since their time together at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). They share social outings and adventures, such as exploring back lanes and woods walks with mutual friends. Priscilla also supports [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in key moments, such as unexpectedly bringing author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and greeting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) to help lift her homesick spirits when she arrives for college.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), +31 more_

Priscilla and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) were intimate friends at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and later lived together with other friends at Patty's Place during their time at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). ### [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla is the niece of the famous author Mrs. Charlotte E. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). She travels with her aunt on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) and accompanies her on a surprise visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to see [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phil-gordon--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) met at Old St. John's Cemetery during their freshman year at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), quickly bonding over their shared experiences. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) was soon brought into Priscilla's social circle, participating in group walks and eventually begging to join Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a housemate at Patty's Place.
